name: VertiMonial
author: Haseeb Abid

sections.description:
VertiMonial is an elegant and SEO-friendly testimonial slider plugin for WordPress. With a vertical auto-scrolling layout, it helps you highlight customer feedback in a visually appealing way that builds trust and engagement.

Built for simplicity and performance, VertiMonial makes it easy to add, manage, and display testimonials directly from your WordPress dashboard. Perfect for portfolios, small businesses, agencies, and personal brands looking to elevate their credibility and social proof.

🔥 Features:

  • Vertical auto-scrolling testimonial slider
  • Clean and modern design
  • Fully responsive across all devices
  • Add client name, role/designation, message, and image
  • Backend testimonial management
  • Lightweight and fast loading
  • Shortcode support: [vertim_testimonials_slider]
  • SEO-optimized output with semantic HTML

Support

Need help or have a suggestion?

📧 Email: haseebabidofficial@gmail.com
🌐 Plugin Page: https://wordpress.org/plugins/vertimonial/

If you enjoy using VertiMonial, please consider leaving a ★★★★★ rating. Your support encourages future updates and new features.

Thank you for using VertiMonial!
sections.installation:
1. Go to your WordPress dashboard.
  2. Navigate to Plugins > Add New.
  3. In the search bar, type VertiMonial and click Install Now.
  4. Once installed, click Activate.
  5. Navigate to the VertiMonial section in your dashboard to start adding testimonials.
  6. Use the shortcode [vertim_testimonials_slider] to display testimonials on any post, page, or widget.
sections.faq:
How do I display testimonials on my site?

Simply use the [vertim_testimonials_slider] shortcode anywhere on a post, page, or widget. It will display the testimonial slider automatically.

Can I add my own testimonials?

Yes, you can add new testimonials from the backend by navigating to VertiMonial > Testimonials.

Can I control how many testimonials are shown?

By default, all published testimonials are shown, but in future updates we may include parameters like limit to control count.

Is VertiMonial mobile responsive?

Absolutely. The slider is fully responsive and works smoothly on all screen sizes and devices.

Will the plugin slow down my website?

Not at all. VertiMonial is lightweight and follows WordPress best practices for performance.

Is it compatible with Elementor, Gutenberg, and WPBakery?

Yes. You can place the shortcode inside any block, widget, or section using these popular page builders.
